title: Marine Pump Evidence Graph Package Schema V3.0
description: Normative package schema for a Chinese-canonical marine-engine-room pump semantic graph with verbatim multilingual EvidenceAssertion records. Claim aggregation must preserve every independently sourced assertion.

record_model.claim_semantics: A Claim is a normalized semantic triple. It is not evidence by itself and is eligible for the released graph only through one or more eligible EvidenceAssertion records.
record_model.multi_source_policy: Assertions from different documents, pages, publishers, or source families must remain distinct and must never be overwritten by Claim-level aggregation.
record_model.semantic_language_policy: Every released CanonicalEntity label is Chinese. Stable entity-type and relation machine codes remain English enums with frozen Chinese display labels.
record_model.evidence_language_policy: EvidenceAssertion surfaces and evidence_text remain verbatim in the source language. Any Chinese evidence translation is non-evidentiary and must not participate in span, entailment, hash, or coverage validation.

node_type_registry.Equipment: A pump, pump set, drive, or explicitly named pump-system equipment.
node_type_registry.Component: A physical component of a pump or its connected suction, discharge, sealing, lubrication, drive, valve, or pipe system.
node_type_registry.FaultMode: An observable or diagnosable failure state.
node_type_registry.FailureMechanism: A physical process through which degradation or failure develops.
node_type_registry.SignalFeature: A measured or computed diagnostic feature.
node_type_registry.Cause: A stated initiating cause that is not merely a component name.
node_type_registry.OperatingCondition: A load, pressure, temperature, flow, speed, medium, or environmental condition.
node_type_registry.InspectionMethod: A named diagnostic or inspection method.
node_type_registry.InspectionAction: A concrete inspection or verification action.
node_type_registry.MaintenanceAction: A concrete repair, adjustment, cleaning, replacement, or preventive-maintenance action.
node_type_registry.Standard: A standard, rule, guide, specification, or acceptance criterion.
node_type_registry.Risk: A stated adverse consequence or risk state.

E1.name: direct_contiguous_span
E1.definition: The complete Claim is supported by a single exact contiguous span on one physical PDF page.

E2.name: verified_visual_table_row
E2.definition: The complete Claim is supported by verbatim cells in one visually verified table row or one bounded table region on one physical PDF page.

E3.name: same_page_multi_span_composition
E3.definition: The Claim requires combining multiple source spans on one page or semantic reconstruction beyond one verified table row.

normative_policies.assertion_deduplication_scope: Only byte-equivalent or canonically equivalent assertions from the same document page and same source geometry may be collapsed.
normative_policies.source_family_independence: Independent-source counts use source_family_id, not file count.
normative_policies.split_isolation: Development and held-out assertions may be evaluated but must not satisfy build-set coverage gates or enter build-only indexes.
normative_policies.silver_naming: All automatically extracted or partially reviewed benchmark and graph evidence is Silver.

prohibited_operations.rule: Do not add triples, intermediate mechanisms, symptoms, causes, or maintenance actions that are not supported by the recorded source evidence.
Do not construct a semantic edge first and later infer its document, page, quotation, or URL from matching entity pairs.
Do not delete an otherwise valid assertion or Claim because its graph degree is low.
Do not choose relation direction by occurrence frequency. Direction must follow the relation registry and the source semantics.
Do not delete valid edges merely to force the released evidence graph to be acyclic.
Do not automatically merge entities solely because embedding similarity exceeds a threshold. Vector similarity may only nominate same-type alias candidates for review.
Do not collapse independently sourced EvidenceAssertion records into one source-less edge.
Inferred or reconstructed edges may be retained only as excluded context and may not enter the core graph or a coverage gate.
Never replace raw source surfaces or evidence_text with a Chinese translation. Optional translations are non-evidentiary reading aids only.
Every released CanonicalEntity must have a Chinese canonical label and an approved terminology or translation status. Model translation alone is insufficient.

canonical_label.description: Released semantic-layer label. It must be a Chinese canonical term and must never replace source-language evidence text.

evidence_text.description: Verbatim source text. Paraphrases and model-completed text are forbidden.

evidence_translation_zh.description: Optional Chinese reading aid. It is non-evidentiary and may not participate in span matching, relation entailment, hashes, or coverage counts.
